title: Rename a field across types, functions, a report and tests, keeping old stored data loadable
prompt: We're renaming users to accounts. In the billing code, rename userId to accountId everywhere: the Invoice type, the functions and their parameters, the report, the reminders, the tests. The stored invoices in data/invoices.json were written with userId and we are not migrating that file, so loading it has to keep working; anything we save from now on should use accountId.
